context: Tests the boundary that a slop pattern hiding a real defect is reported, not polished: the defensive catch returning a zeroed Config silently breaks the caller's fail-loudly-on-bad-config contract, so the agent must flag it rather than tidy it or silently change behavior.

checklist.name: Defect reported
checklist.description: The response explicitly flags the catch block as a real problem: swallowing the parse error and returning { apiUrl: '', timeoutMs: 0 } contradicts the caller's expectation that startup fails loudly on bad config

checklist.name: No silent behavior change
checklist.description: The agent does not silently delete the catch (a behavior change) under the guise of cleaning; any proposed semantic fix is presented as a reported defect or explicit recommendation, not smuggled into the pass

checklist.name: Cosmetic slop still cleaned
checklist.description: Narrating comments ('Read the configuration file from disk', 'Parse the JSON content') and the 'Robust... comprehensive' header are removed

checklist.name: Defect not polished
checklist.description: The 'Gracefully handle any parsing issues' comment is not rewritten into nicer prose that keeps the swallow in place looking intentional

checklist.name: Validation gap noted
checklist.description: The response notes that a successful JSON.parse is returned as Config without validating the shape, or otherwise scopes what a real fix would cover
